objective: Take the dependabot python dependency bump and regenerate the development lock so the pinned distributions and the constraint ranges agree again.
decision_supported: Do the bumped constraint ranges need a new lock, or can the old one stand? The lock is a hash-pinned record, so it has to be regenerated.
acceptance: lock-python-verify reports that the lock matches the declared requirements.
No declared requirement falls outside the lock's pinned versions.
stop_conditions: Regenerating the lock would drop a distribution the constraints require.
risks_and_fallbacks: A regenerated lock could pull a version outside the declared range; verify catches that.
Fallback: revert the lock commit and keep the previous pin.
